spec.full_target: For every prime p, every field K of characteristic p, every integer lambda with 0 <= lambda < p, and every admissible lattice M in the irreducible complex sl2-module V(lambda), prove M tensor_Z K is irreducible under sl2(K).
spec.conclusion: For every prime p, every field K of characteristic p, every integer lambda with 0 <= lambda < p, and every admissible lattice M in the irreducible complex sl2-module V(lambda), M tensor_Z K is irreducible under sl2(K).

calculations: Finite matrix-unit calculations and localization at p

propositions.statement: For every prime p, every field K of characteristic p, every integer lambda with 0 <= lambda < p, and every admissible lattice M in the irreducible complex sl2-module V(lambda), M tensor_Z K is irreducible under sl2(K).

argument.text: Fix arbitrary p,K,lambda,M as in the target. Write R=Z_(p), and let e_i=y^i v_+/i! (0<=i<=lambda), where v_+ is a highest-weight vector. The standard sl2 relations give that these form a complex basis and that X_r=x^r/r! and Y_r=y^r/r! act by X_r e_i=binom(lambda-i+r,r)e_(i-r) and Y_r e_i=binom(i+r,r)e_(i+r), with terms outside 0..lambda zero. These formulas follow by repeated use of [h,x]=2x,[h,y]=-2y,[x,y]=h and x v_+=0,hv_+=lambda v_+. Thus all divided powers preserve the Z_(p)-span of coordinates. Let M_R=R tensor_Z M. Admissibility gives stability under divided powers. In their associative operator algebra define E_ij as the usual coordinate matrix units: Y_lambda X_lambda=E_lambdalambda; X_(lambda-i)E_lambdalambda=E_i lambda; E_lambdalambda Y_(lambda-j)=binom(lambda,j)E_lambda j. Since lambda<p, each binomial(lambda,j) is a unit of R, so E_ij=E_i lambda E_lambda j belongs to that operator algebra. Consequently every E_ij preserves M_R. For each i put J_i={c in C:c e_i in M_R}. E_ii M_R=J_i e_i, so J_i is a finitely generated R-module as the image of the finite R-module M_R under E_ii; it is nonzero because M_R spans the complex module. E_ij preservation gives J_j subset J_i and the reverse using E_ji, so all J_i equal J. The identity sum E_ii=1 gives M_R=direct_sum_i J e_i. Since M_R is free of rank lambda+1 over the discrete valuation ring R, J is finite torsion-free of rank one, hence free rank one over R. Choose an R-module isomorphism R to J. This identifies M_R with the standard coordinate module over R, intertwining x,y,h. Reduction modulo p and extension of scalars identify M tensor_Z K with the standard (lambda+1)-dimensional module over K. For each r<=lambda<p, r! is a unit modulo p, so X_r and Y_r are scalar multiples of x^r and y^r on this module. The displayed identities therefore show that the associative algebra generated by x,y contains every E_ij over K. Any submodule W is stable under x,y and hence under all E_ij. If a nonzero vector w=sum c_i e_i lies in W, select c_i nonzero; then E_ji w=c_i e_j for every j, so W contains every basis vector by K-linearity. Hence W is the whole module. Its dimension lambda+1 is positive, including lambda=0. This proves the target for every admissible lattice, including p=2.
